_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/ledger/test_surveilled_this_turn.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_surveil_scavenger` is an Edgar-shaped permission narrowed to cards surveilled this turn; `t_surveil_crucible` is Crucible of Worlds narrowed the same way. `t_surveil_eye` is Eye of Duskmantle's permission without the keywords, for tests/unit/casting/test_graveyard_pay_life_instead.py.

cards.name: Test Surveil Scavenger
cards.oracle_text: Once during each of your turns, you may cast a spell from among cards in your graveyard you've surveilled this turn.

abilities.text: Once during each of your turns, you may cast a spell from among cards in your graveyard you've surveilled this turn.
